description: This file is a Markdown document that documents the API methods of the RDKShell Plugin, detailing various methods, their parameters, examples, and events. It is a documentation file, not a traditional source code or script.

methods.name: setHolePunch
methods.description: Enables or disables video hole punching for the specified client.

methods.name: setInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the inactivity notification interval and triggers related events.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the logging level for the system.

methods.name: setMemoryMonitor
methods.description: Enables or disables RAM memory monitoring with specific thresholds and intervals.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity level of a specified client.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Scales an application to specified x and y factors.

methods.name: setScreenResolution
methods.description: Sets the screen resolution with width and height.

methods.name: setTopmost
methods.description: Sets whether a client appears above all other clients, optionally focusing it.

methods.name: setVirtualResolution
methods.description: Sets the virtual resolution for a client.

methods.name: setVisibility
methods.description: Sets whether the specified client should be visible.

methods.name: setGraphicsFrameRate
methods.description: Sets the graphics frame rate.

methods.name: showCursor
methods.description: Shows the cursor using the current cursor size.

methods.name: showFullScreenImage
methods.description: Displays a full-screen image from a specified path.

methods.name: showSplashLogo
methods.description: Displays the splash screen for a specified duration.

methods.name: showWatermark
methods.description: Sets whether a watermark is shown on the display.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends an application and triggers suspension events.

methods.name: suspendApplication
methods.description: Suspends an application based on its client callsign.

methods.name: keyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Customizes key repeat behavior including enabling/disabling, delay, and interval.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Blocks or unblocks AV for a given callsign, effectively blacklisting or removing from blacklist.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of blacklisted AV applications.
